description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProjectAnalyticsForm' for handling form processing related to project analytics settings, including Google Analytics IDs and Facebook Pixel identifiers within the Goteo project.

classes.name: ProjectAnalyticsForm
classes.description: A form processor class for managing project analytics settings, including validation and saving of Google Analytics IDs and Facebook Pixel data.

methods.name: getGoogleAnalyticsConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints (regex pattern) for Google Analytics ID input.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes the form with fields for analytics ID and Facebook Pixel, including their labels, requirement status, constraints, and help text.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the form data into the project model, handling errors if validation or save operations fail.
